title.th: คำสั่งภาพยนตร์ (ระดับการจำแนกประเภท) 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Films (Classification Ratings) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 1 July 2021.

heading.en: Classification ratings, etc., for video games

text.en:
3. The classification ratings for video games, and their respective classification markings and information, are set out in —
(a)Part 1 of the First Schedule — for video games classified before 1 July 2021 and are distributed before, on or after that date; and
(b)Part 2 of the First Schedule —
(i)for video games classified on or after 1 July 2021; or
(ii)for video games classified before 1 July 2021 and are distributed on or after that date.

heading.en: Classification ratings, etc., for other films

text.en:
4. The classification ratings for films that are not video games, and their respective classification markings, alternative classification markings (if any) and information, are set out in —
(a)Part 1 of the Second Schedule — for films classified before 1 July 2021 and are distributed before, on or after that date or are not distributed;
(b)Part 2 of the Second Schedule — for films classified on or after 1 July 2021 and are not distributed; and
(c)Part 3 of the Second Schedule —
(i)for films classified on or after 1 July 2021 and are distributed on or after that date; or
(ii)for films classified before 1 July 2021 and are distributed on or after that date.
5. The Films (Classification Ratings) Order 2019 (G.N. No. S 340/2019) is revoked.
